shared_prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one implementation-ready Reel Travel desktop web interface screenshot. Generate one single, straight-on, flat desktop interface at landscape 16:10, matching the supplied Reel Travel Editorial Blue references in proportions, polish, spacing, and frame language. References define visual style and shell only, not factual evidence. Visual system: warm off-white canvas, white cards, ink-black text, vivid cobalt-blue actions and selections, pale blue highlights, fine cool-gray borders, subtle shadows, 10-12px radii. Elegant high-contrast serif only for editorial page titles; modern sans-serif for navigation, labels and controls. Precise line icons and generous practical spacing. No gradients, glassmorphism, device frame, perspective, collage, or multiple screens. Product truth: all destinations, venue content, bookings, sources, maps, ratings, reviews, reels, and images are synthetic design examples unless merely atmospheric. Unknown values remain unknown. Include quiet footer DESIGN CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA. All visible text correctly spelled and readable.
